**Summary:** [FE] Auto-calculate Total Cost in Financing Offer Edit Form
**Type:** Zadanie | **Priority:** Medium

**Description:**
Goal Update the existing financing offer edit form so that 
total_cost
 is no longer user-editable and is instead automatically calculated on the frontend based on other form values. The calculated 
total_cost
 must be included in the payload sent to the existing update endpoint. Background Currently, the 
total_cost
 field is editable in the financing offer edit form. New business decision: total_cost
 must be calculated automatically by FE the user must not edit it manually FE must recalculate it whenever any dependent field changes when saving the form, FE must send the calculated 
total_cost
 to API For now, this logic will live only on the frontend. API Context Endpoint remains unchanged: PATCH /v1/financial-institution/financing-request/{referenceId}/parameters/absolute Payload remains unchanged: FE still sends full payload total_cost
 must be sent as the calculated value Calculation Formula Frontend must calculate: total_cost = down_payment + final_payment + financing_term * monthly_outflow + administrative_fees + license_plate_fee + energy_efficiency_fee Fields used in calculation Use the following form/API values: down_payment final_payment financing_period monthly_outflow administrative_fees license_plate_fee energy_efficiency_fee Use the field names already used in the form model / API client. Required UI Changes 1. Make 
total_cost
 read-only / non-editable Field: total_cost Rules: user must not be able to edit it manually remove editable behavior keep field visible in the form display the calculated value Preferred behavior: show it as disabled or read-only, depending on existing UX pattern value should update live when dependent fields change 2. Recalculate automatically on dependent field change FE must recalculate 
total_cost
 whenever any of these values changes: down_payment final_payment monthly_outflow financing_period administrative_fees license_plate_fee energy_efficiency_fee This includes recalculation during: initial form load user editing programmatic updates to form values 3. Submission behavior On submit: FE must send the calculated 
total_cost do not send stale or user-entered value calculated value must overwrite any previous manual value in form state Calculation Rules 1. Numeric safety All calculation inputs must be treated as numeric values. If any field is empty / null / undefined: treat it as 
0
 for calculation purposes 2. Recalculation timing The displayed 
total_cost
 must always match the latest form state before submit. 3. Formatting Keep existing SAR formatting/display rules Internal calculation should use raw numeric values Preserve current rounding strategy used in form numeric fields If no rounding strategy exists, do not introduce arbitrary formatting logic beyond existing app behavior Acceptance Criteria The 
total_cost
 field is visible but not editable by the user. total_cost
 is automatically calculated in FE using the formula: total_cost = down_payment + final_payment + financing_term * monthly_outflow + administrative_fees + license_plate_fee + energy_efficiency_fee The 
total_cost
 value updates automatically whenever any dependent field changes. Empty or missing dependent values are treated as 
0
 in the calculation. On initial form load, 
total_cost
 is calculated from current form values and displayed correctly. On submit, FE sends the calculated 
total_cost
 in the request payload. User cannot manually override the calculated 
total_cost
 value in the UI. Existing validation, loading, and error handling continue to work. No regression is introduced for editing other financing offer fields. Non-Goals Do not move this calculation to BE Do not change API contract Do not introduce backend recalculation logic Do not modify unrelated financial field behavior Implementation Notes (for AI Agent) Remove manual edit capability for 
total_cost Add derived calculation logic based on current form state Ensure hidden/non-editable fields required by payload are still preserved Recompute on every relevant field change Prevent stale 
total_cost
 from remaining in state after dependent values change Check whether 
license_plate_fee
 and 
energy_efficiency_fee
 are already present in form state; if not, use values from loaded financing request data Keep the calculation logic centralized in one place to avoid inconsistencies between display value and submitted payload
